elements.element: Governing law is the laws of the State of New York
elements.evidence: "governed exclusively by the laws of the State of New York"

elements.element: Exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County
elements.evidence: "the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York have exclusive jurisdiction" (28.1 and 28.2)

elements.element: Governing law is Delaware, California, or England and Wales
elements.evidence: "the laws of the State of New York" — outside the fallback set (fallback is a separate bargain)

elements.element: Corresponding forum: Delaware/California courts or the courts of London
elements.evidence: "courts located in New York County, New York" — not a fallback forum

offending_extra_words: and the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York have exclusive jurisdiction
reasons: Preferred level is complete: 28.1 now selects New York law with exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts of New York County, a permitted corresponding pair, and the Singapore law/forum conflict is removed.
Fallback is not and need not be satisfied; the locked target is preferred and the two levels cannot be mixed.

Minimality fails: 28.2 already confers exclusive jurisdiction on the state and federal courts in New York County, so re-stating the forum in 28.1 duplicates existing protection and expands 13 words to 27. A tighter edit (swap "Singapore law" for "the laws of the State of New York" and delete the redundant Singapore forum wording) would have sufficed.

Intent is preserved: no unrelated term is disturbed, no undefined term or dangling mechanic is introduced, and the pre-existing temporary-injunctive-relief carve-out in 28.2 is untouched (it is mutual and not adverse to us), though it remains a residual qualification on strict exclusivity and could be noted in the rationale rather than redlined.
